profile.headline: Sr. Principal Software Developer at ASRC Federal Vistronix

positions.title: Sr. Principal Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Establish a Vehicular Integration for C4ISR/EW Interoperability (VICTORY) Software Integration Lab (SIL) at Intelligence and Information Warfare Directorate (I2WD).
•	Define a VICTORY implementation that identifies the physical/logical components that will be instantiated into the VICTORY Data Bus (VDB).
•	Integrate components of the VICTORY Reference Implementation (RI) to provide capabilities relevant to the Electronic Warfare (EW) mission.
•	Develop VDB Adapters to translate non-compliant system interfaces to VICTORY Data Messages (VDM) and VICTORY Management Interfaces to enable interoperability over the VDB.
•	Support all development, integration, and demonstration activities that leverage the I2WD VICTORY SIL.
•	Participate in the appropriate Vehicular Integration for C4ISR/EW Interoperability (VICTORY) working groups to define and document a Radio Frequency (RF) Switch component type and associated interfaces.  
•	Develop a VICTORY Data Bus (VDB) Adapter for the RF Switch and Duke V3 system to translate between the native and VICTORY standard interfaces to enable interoperability over the VDB.
•	Develop a Distributed Antenna Array (DAA) Expert System by extending the Cooperative Electronic Warfare Expert System (CEWES) previously developed for Counter Radio Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare (CREW) Science and Technology (S&T).
•	Coordinate with external contractors to assist in diagnosis and resolution of software interaction issues.
•	Develop interfaces between Modular Open RF Architecture (MORA) and VICTORY to provide VICTORY-compliant software suitable for embedding, implementing EW management, authentication, health publishing, VICTORY Configuration Language (VCL), etc.
•	Apply Information Assurance (IA) enhancement to MORA reference adapters.
•	Apply WSDL updates (VICTORY/MORA) to existing projects, updating and testing code for compatibility and integrity.

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.description:
* Served as the sole local developer in cooperation with, but independent of, Smithkline-Beecham staff. Adapted Solaris-based C and Motif modules for execution in a Windows NT environment, eventually extending its range to include Redhat Linux and Windows 2000 compatibility. Redesigned legacy VMS-based PL/I modules into C for Solaris and Windows.

* Created knowledge base editor GUIs in C and Motif. Conducted research and development in machine-learning strategies. Supplied or corrected contents of knowledge base on the basis of less-than-satisfactory testing results, adding software functionality as needed to accommodate additional forms of knowledge.

* Realized impressive gains in quality and throughput of problem-solving performance through dedicated debugging and innovative heuristic design and enhancement.

* Corrected faulty or undesirable behavior in lesstif open software for improved compliance with OSF Motif standards.

* Made "Portable SYNCHEM" a reality through its adaptation for both environments (Windows 2000 and Redhat Linux) of dual-boot notebook computers, which enabled its satisfactory demonstration in conjunction with a poster session at ACS Prospectives, Barcelona, Spain.

* Prepared non-modifiable beta-test installation CD; prepared and installed fully functional, yet doubly (physically and virtually) encrypted venture evaluation version on remote platform.

* Enhanced flexibility of machine-learning analysis to accommodate a number of previously problematic reaction description formats.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
* Developed character-based UI's in Progress 4GL using proprietary STRIDE/CreditRevue 2000 architecture tools to enforce modularity, object-oriented UI design, and compatibility with update access by a Maestro global overseer application. Enhanced and corrected software in response to QA and Y2K issues and standards.

* Modified schema as needed for optimal indexing efficiency. Contributed to libraries of method, widget, and rule objects.  Customized tables and their interfaces to accommodate specific additional needs of individual clients.

* Dealt successfully with clients in after-hours resolution of issues arising through on-site testing of the system. 

* Created global specifications for system expansion projects, for which only minor revisions were suggested upon supervisory review. 

* Demonstrated rapid ability to understand and work effectively with object-oriented database concepts despite very limited prior experience.

company.name: Credit Management Solutions Inc. (now First American CMSI)

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
* Developed GUI's in C and Xlib or GL for anatomical analysis in neuroimaging studies, brain-mapping, and computer-guided surgery, including a voxel-mapped interpolation of the Talairach-Tourneaux stereotactic atlas of the human brain and the ability to reshape it in
all three planes for a stereotactic best-fit overlay.

* Created a dynamic, elasticity-driven, three-dimensional curvature-mapping of the cerebral cortex from a set of MRI slices as well as a two-dimensional projection of the sulcal delineations. Designed the prototype website in both HTML and CGI, describing the neuroradiological research effort and affording dynamic access to the voxel-labeled atlas.

* Resolved the lack of computer-readable format for Talairach-Tourneaux stereotactic brain atlas, the standard for neuroradiological studies as well as reduced the limitations of linear stereotactic transformations in *warping* the atlas brains to individual brain shapes and dimensions, especially with respect to cortical sulci.

* Managed AIX system, including TCP/IP configuration and troubleshooting; performed Solaris kernel modifications needed for peripheral hardware installation.

* Streamlined data utilization through remote process control (RPC) and incorporation of ISG/IAP object libraries into GUI. 

* Developed stereo projection of brain atlas and cubic grid display of
orthogonal misalignments for reference in optimizing interpolation. 

* Demonstrated resourcefulness in obtaining coordinate data from a tracing grid peripheral for which no specifications were available and in merging red-, green-, and blue-filtered monochrome digital scans into a label-ready prototype of the computerized atlas.

positions.title: Process Control Consultant
positions.description: 160" Plate Mill Automation System at Bethlehem Steel Corporation, Sparrows Point, MD

positions.title: Senior Research Associate
positions.description:
* Participated in education and training activities, via alternation of testing and knowledge base enhancement, of the SYNCHEM expert problem-solving system.

* Successively enhanced interface from command-driven to full-screen UI, followed by full GUI functionality.

* Enabled multiple-library searches to allow separation of proprietary and public-domain chemistry.

* Reformatted the reaction library and related files to constrain record sizes within the maximum DECNET packet size. Provided staff guidance for programming and usage at sponsoring Eastman Kodak and NASA Lewis Research.
